title: Two questions about the user interface
author: vndnua
body_snippet: 1. When I move (using the mouse or keyboard) an existing connection in the tree, nothing visually happens. The element is actually being moved; it’s just that the tree isn’t being redrawn. If I create a new connection or delete an existing one, the connection tree is updated immediately and the changes are visible. 2. comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks both — these are two independent things, so let me split them.

**1. Tree not redrawing when you move a connection in place — fixed.**
Reordering a connection inside its current folder (mouse drag or keyboard) was updating the data but not repainting the tree, so nothing appeared to move; add/delete worked because they take a different refresh path.
